name: - AUR
fix_description: Add onlyOwner modifier to changeRewardPerNode(). Currently any external caller can set rewardPerDay to an arbitrary value and drain rewards.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward missing access control exploit: the attacker directly calls admin-like functions to change node price and reward rate, then creates a node and claims inflated rewards. The PoC is short, requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning, and uses only a simple buy/claim/sell flow without flash loans or complex multi-contract interactions.
